items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: And I was with Woody’s band. And he gave me two weeks off to get married.

ctx.x: Yeah. And she says, “you used to try to louse us up every night with that two bar solo you played, we’d all get out of step.” So I think you mentioned being on the road. So I got married, it must have been a year or two after that. We got married. And I was with Woody’s band. And he gave me two weeks off to get married. So we came home and we got — nothing special, no big wedding or anything like that.
You weren’t throwing sandwiches, were you?
